question: Where is the nearest attraction as you travel in the direction of Sunrise Art Studio, Clifton, NJ from Children's Cultural Center of Native America, New York, NY?
sql: WITH start_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Children''s Cultural Center of Native America%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' LIMIT 1 ), end_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sunrise Art Studio%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Clifton%' LIMIT 1 ), travel_bearing AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, ep.geometry)) AS bearing_deg FROM start_poi sp, end_poi ep ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_poi sp, travel_bearing tb WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction' AND ST_Distance(sp.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) > 0 -- Exclude the start point itself AND ( -- Calculate the angular distance between the bearing from start to attraction -- and the bearing from start to destination. -- Filter for attractions within a 45-degree cone of the travel direction. LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - tb.bearing_deg), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - tb.bearing_deg) ) <= 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(sp.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
